verdict.rationale: Zamzar's API documents a per-format lookup. Its JSON response for a format such as GIF lists 'the target file formats which Zamzar can convert GIFs to', so a user can check a pair before submitting a job. The website also lists specific pairs such as PNG to ICO, PDF to DWG and MP3 to Text, and the developer site claims over 1,100 conversions. Missing for 10: a published, browsable input-to-output conversion matrix in the evidence, documentation of the formats endpoint beyond the single GIF example, a machine-readable spec (the OpenAPI, llms.txt and docs.md probes all returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the tool documents which input formats convert to which outputs, so I can check a pair before trying it

citations.quote: The JSON response provides some information about the GIF file format, such as the target file formats which Zamzar can convert GIFs to.
Use the API to perform over 1,100 different conversions.
